prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one portrait low-fidelity UX sketch for a shoelaundry cashier mobile app, 3:4 aspect, representing a focused Detail Pesanan component at a 390x520 logical size, no phone/device bezel, no OS. One design, not a collage. White background, black and gray only. Slightly handdrawn rectangular boxes, but exceptionally clear large printed Indonesian text. No colors.
Reference image 1 is contextual research only: it shows existing payment record information, not a style template and not a layout target. Do not reproduce its blue/green/orange UI or Rp57.000 amount.
Concept: accordion/progressive disclosure in the same canonical order detail. Header 'Detail Pesanan', second line 'PSN-015 | Bank Transfer | Rp150.000'. Four accordion headers exactly 'Ringkasan Pesanan', 'Pembayaran', 'Pemeriksaan', 'Tindak Lanjut'. Ringkasan Pesanan collapsed. Pembayaran may be shallow open: 'Pembayaran tercatat' with small helper 'Belum memastikan dana masuk'. Pemeriksaan is the clearly open primary accordion: 'Menunggu hasil', 'Pemeriksa: Owner', 'Hasil belum tersedia', and outlined large button 'Lihat permintaan'. Tindak Lanjut collapsed, but below it an obviously inactive gray outlined 'Teruskan' button and readable reason 'Menunggu hasil yang memadai'. All four named sections must be shown, visibly within ONE screen; no separate-page navigation. Small 'Data ilustrasi' at bottom. Keep to these short labels, generous white space, avoid dense prose, no large branding, no option number/title. No bank access, no fund approval by admin, no automatic integration, no ETA, no invented result while waiting. Main visual model must clearly be accordion.
qa: Visual inspected inline; labels accurate; no clipped text; inactive Teruskan and waiting status clear.
